alexbeav-the-mummy-recomp: Use your own USA The Mummy disc, SLUS-01187, with its single data track intact. Portcove checks the files and builds the player.
alexbeav-threads-of-fate-recomp: Use your own Threads of Fate (USA, Canada) disc (SLUS-01019) with its single data track and your own retail SCPH-1001 BIOS. Portcove checks the files and builds the player.
alexbeav-tokyo-highway-battle-recomp: Use your own Tokyo Highway Battle (USA) disc (SLUS-00229) with all 8 of its tracks and your own retail SCPH-1001 BIOS. Portcove checks the files and builds the player.
alexbeav-tony-hawk-s-pro-skater-2-recomp: Select your own matching game files and the required BIOS. Portcove checks the files and builds the player.
alexbeav-tony-hawk-s-pro-skater-3-recomp: Select your own matching game files and the required BIOS. Portcove checks the files and builds the player.
alexbeav-tony-hawk-s-pro-skater-4-recomp: Select your own matching game files and the required BIOS. Portcove checks the files and builds the player.
alexbeav-tony-hawk-s-pro-skater-recomp: Select your own matching game files and the required BIOS. Portcove checks the files and builds the player.
alexbeav-valkyrie-profile-recomp: Use your own Valkyrie Profile (USA) two-disc set (SLUS-01156, SLUS-01179), each disc with its single data track, and your own retail SCPH-1001 BIOS. Portcove checks the files and builds the player.
alexbeav-vampire-hunter-d-recomp: Use your own USA Vampire Hunter D disc, SLUS-01138, with its single data track intact. Portcove checks the files and builds the player.
alexbeav-vib-ribbon-recomp: Select your own matching game files and the required BIOS. Portcove checks the files and builds the player.
alexbeav-vigilante-8-recomp: Use your own Europe Vigilante 8 disc, SLES-01212, with all 13 tracks present. Portcove checks the files and builds the player.
alexbeav-wild-arms-recomp: Use your own Wild Arms (USA) disc (SCUS-94608) with its single data track and your own retail SCPH-1001 BIOS. Portcove checks the files and builds the player.
alexbeav-wipeout-xl-recomp: Select your own matching game files and the required BIOS. Portcove checks the files and builds the player.
body-harvest-recompiled: Use Load ROM to select your own North American Body Harvest cartridge dump. The player verifies and remembers a private copy in its profile, alongside settings and saves. Back up that profile separately before changing versions.
diablo-devilutionx: Choose a folder or ZIP containing the matching DIABDAT.MPQ from your own original Diablo.
diablo-hellfire-devilutionx: Choose a folder or ZIP containing your own matching DIABDAT.MPQ, hellfire.mpq, hfmonk.mpq, hfmusic.mpq and hfvoice.mpq.
djultra64-blocksphere: Portcove installs the managed Blocksphere package. On first Play, choose your own Tetrisphere US NTPE revision 0 cartridge dump or ZIP in the game.
doom-3-classic-dhewm3: Choose the folder containing base from your own classic Doom 3 installation patched to 1.3.1. Portcove checks and prepares the nine original PK4 files, then you can select Play. BFG Edition is a different product. Keep your original installation separately. On Windows, keep the managed library path short and use plain ASCII. On Linux, keep the packaged modules and install SDL2, OpenAL, libcurl and the GNU C++ and GCC runtime libraries. Keep backups of the external save and settings folders. Use a separately prepared copy for custom paths or native mods.
doom-3-resurrection-of-evil-classic-dhew: Choose the folder containing base and d3xp from your own classic Doom 3 and Resurrection of Evil installation patched to 1.3.1. Portcove checks and prepares the base and expansion PK4 files, then you can select Play. BFG Edition is a different product. Keep your original installation separately. On Windows, keep the managed library path short and use plain ASCII. On Linux, keep the packaged modules and install SDL2, OpenAL, libcurl and the GNU C++ and GCC runtime libraries. Keep backups of the external save and settings folders. Use a separately prepared copy for custom paths or native mods.
dune-ii-dune-dynasty: Follow upstream’s FILELIST.TXT. On Windows, place the original files in Dune Dynasty/data under your Windows roaming app-data folder, normally %APPDATA%. On Linux, place them in dunedynasty/data under your XDG data location, normally ~/.local/share. Settings and saves use the XDG config location, normally ~/.config/dunedynasty. Keep originals and dunedynasty.cfg outside the managed game folder.
elasota-aerofoil: Choose Play to open the packaged houses. Aerofoil creates its player profile in your Windows Documents location. Use the separate upstream tools and a prepared copy if you want to import and manage other content outside this route.
heroes-of-might-and-magic-ii-fheroes2: Copy your own supported Heroes II ANIM, DATA, MAPS and MUSIC directories when present. Use HOME/.fheroes2 on Windows or Intel Mac, or APPDATA/fheroes2 on Windows when HOME is unset. On Linux, use XDG_DATA_HOME/fheroes2 or ~/.local/share/fheroes2. Use absolute personal profile locations outside the managed game folder and the same account and environment for setup and Play.
kirby-letsgo-oracles-decomp: Portcove installs the Windows Oracles player. After installation, choose Play and use Add ROM to select your own supported Oracle of Ages or Oracle of Seasons cartridge dump.
monster-hunter-portable-3rd-hd-yakumo: On first Play, choose the uncompressed PSP UMD ISO from your own Monster Hunter Portable 3rd HD Ver. PS3 release (NPJB-40001) and let Yakumo prepare the game. If Yakumo copies the image, the copy is kept and backed up with the managed data. If you use the image where it is, keep it at a stable location outside the managed runtime and back it up yourself.
n64hub-rayman-2-recomp-n64-usa: Use Load ROM to select your own 32 MiB, big-endian Rayman 2 USA .z64 (SHA-1 50558356b059ad3fbaf5fe95380512b9dceaaf52). The player verifies it and keeps a private copy in its profile with settings and Controller Pak files. Back up that profile separately before changing versions.
n64hub-super-smash-bros-n64-usa-recomp: Use Load ROM to select your own 16 MiB, big-endian Super Smash Bros. USA .z64 (SHA-1 e2929e10fccc0aa84e5776227e798abc07cedabf). The player verifies it and keeps a private copy in its profile with SRAM and settings. Back up that profile separately before changing versions.
nhl-94-genesis-ninety-four: On first Play, select your own supported 1 MiB NHL ’94 Genesis US/Europe ROM in the upstream picker. Keep it at a stable location outside the managed runtime.
quake-ironwail: Open the managed runtime folder and copy the id1 folder containing pak0.pak and pak1.pak from your own classic Quake installation beside the Ironwail program before Play. Keep the original copy in its existing location. Portcove starts this copy from that local base folder and disables the online add-on server.

quake-vkquake.note: After installation, copy the id1 folder with pak0.pak and pak1.pak from your original Quake installation into the managed player’s working folder before choosing Play. Keep your original copy.
warnings: Use a Vulkan-capable GPU and driver.
Use a separately prepared copy for store discovery, rerelease data, expansions, mods, multiuser settings or custom base directories.
Save compatibility across vkQuake versions is still unverified.

linux-x86-64: For vkQuake 1.37.0, the publisher requires glibc 2.35 or later and FUSE to run the AppImage. Check these before installing. Keep the AppImage intact and use lowercase id1 and PAK filenames.

rustmania-racing-ray-m-w-muppet-racemani: Choose Play. If no readable disc is configured, enter the full path to your own supported disc image in the game window. Keep the disc files outside the Portcove runtime. Choose a path without # so the game can remember it in its profile.
snprecomp-wootbeer-sin-and-punishment: Choose Load ROM and select your own supported Japanese or English Sin and Punishment ROM (see Check the required game files). The player keeps a copy in its snprecomp profile, with separate saves for Japanese and English. Back up that profile separately before changing versions.
toy-story-2-buzz-lightyear-to-the-rescue: Choose Load ROM in the SpaceRanger title screen. The player verifies and stores a private copy in spaceranger-config. Keep your independent original and use Start Game in the same player.
troyedwardsjr-z2rs: Choose Play to start the direct z2rs player. Drag your own supported USA NES ROM onto the game window. The player reads it in place and remembers its path. Keep the ROM outside the managed runtime. Use upstream setup for the separate launcher and Android.
vcmi-vcmi: Use a separate official VCMI Launcher to import your own Heroes III game data into the default Windows profile. Close the launcher before choosing Play in Portcove.
xena-warrior-princess-xena-recomp: Select your own matching game files and the required BIOS. Portcove checks the files and builds the player.
